author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play the free demo for FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH now on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order the game today to earn digital bonuses: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH is the second installment in the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, a reimagining of the iconic original game into three standalone titles by its original creators. Play the demo and transfer your save data to the full game when it releases on June 3. Pre-order the physical Nintendo Switch 2 edition to receive a Magic: The Gathering—FINAL FANTASY "Zack Fair" card, featuring a variant art by Tetsuya Nomura, while supplies last!
